note: Machine-readable form of kb/vmem_rule.md. Identity, target, class, action and aliases only: no doses, concentrations or exposure regimes. vmem is 'depolarize', 'hyperpolarize' or null; null is the only non-direction. Agent-level 'vmem' overrides the class rule and is omitted unless the agent's own mechanism contradicts its class default. v2: adds pilot gap agents and aliases only (kb/lookup_gaps_pilot.json); every v1 class_rule and agent keeps its target, class, action and vmem; new classes are listed in kb/vmem_rule_v2_additions.md. Whole-string 'plus' arms are entered as single combination agents with a 'components' list.
